en-US.name: Tianhua Oliver Wang
en-US.description: Research interests in climate finance, green finance policy, project-level green infrastructure financing, and risk pricing.
en-US.intro: Understanding how capital, policy, and risk shape the transition to a low-carbon economy.
en-US.profile_text: Climate finance, green finance policy, and infrastructure investment.
about: My interests lie at the intersection of climate finance and public policy, with a particular focus on project-level green infrastructure financing and risk pricing.
I am interested in how policy influences the allocation of capital, how climate-related risks enter financing decisions, and how these mechanisms affect green infrastructure investment.

en-US.research_intro: Three connected areas of research interest, moving from policy and capital allocation to individual projects and the pricing of risk.

areas.title: Climate Finance & Risk Pricing
areas.summary: How climate-related risks influence financing costs and investment decisions.
areas.question: How are physical and transition risks reflected in the cost of capital for green infrastructure projects?

areas.title: Green Finance Policy
areas.summary: How public policy shapes capital allocation and incentives for green investment.
areas.question: How do green finance policies affect access to financing and the allocation of capital across projects?

areas.title: Green Infrastructure Financing
areas.summary: How project-level financing arrangements support low-carbon infrastructure.
areas.question: How do project characteristics and financing arrangements influence the allocation of risks among investors?

zh-CN.name: Tianhua Oliver Wang
zh-CN.description: 关注气候金融、绿色金融政策、项目级绿色基础设施融资与风险定价。
zh-CN.eyebrow: 气候 · 金融 · 政策
zh-CN.intro: 关注资本、政策与风险如何共同影响低碳经济转型。
zh-CN.profile_text: 气候金融、绿色金融政策与基础设施投资。
about: 我的研究兴趣位于气候金融与公共政策的交叉领域，尤其关注项目级绿色基础设施融资与风险定价。
我希望理解政策如何影响资本配置、气候相关风险如何进入融资决策，以及这些机制如何作用于绿色基础设施投资。
zh-CN.bio_pending: 个人简介与学校信息将于后续补充。
zh-CN.research_intro: 三个相互关联的研究方向，从政策与资本配置延伸至具体项目及其风险定价。

areas.title: 气候金融与风险定价
areas.summary: 关注气候相关风险如何影响融资成本与投资决策。
areas.question: 物理风险与转型风险如何体现在绿色基础设施项目的资本成本中？

areas.title: 绿色金融政策
areas.summary: 关注公共政策如何影响资本配置与绿色投资激励。
areas.question: 绿色金融政策如何影响项目的融资可得性与项目之间的资本配置？

areas.title: 绿色基础设施融资
areas.summary: 关注项目层面的融资安排如何支持低碳基础设施建设。
areas.question: 项目特征与融资安排如何影响投资者之间的风险分担？

zh-HK.name: Tianhua Oliver Wang
zh-HK.description: 關注氣候金融、綠色金融政策、項目層面的綠色基建融資與風險定價。

zh-HK.profile_text: 氣候金融、綠色金融政策與基建投資。
about: 我的研究興趣涵蓋氣候金融與公共政策的交叉領域，尤其關注項目層面的綠色基建融資與風險定價。
